detailZones.title: Car operating panel
detailZones.description: Identify the visible lift controls, tactile buttons, indicator window, speaker grille and panel edges.

detailZones.title: Doors and entry
detailZones.description: Follow the open entrance, door leaves, frame, header, tracks, sill and floor transition.

detailZones.title: Mirror and wall panels
detailZones.description: Inspect the mirror, brushed steel, oak veneer, wall-panel joints and protective trim.

detailZones.title: Handrail and accessible space
detailZones.description: Follow the continuous side handrails, end caps, mounts and clear standing area inside the cab.

detailZones.title: Ceiling and lighting
detailZones.description: Explore the smooth metal ceiling panels, recessed lights, panel seams and light diffusers.

detailZones.title: Floor and sill
detailZones.description: Identify the speckled carpet surface, entrance sill, threshold edge and metal floor strip.

anchorAudit.rationale: The source image was inspected at native resolution. The view shows the complete lift car, operating panel, mirror, handrails, wall finishes, open doors and floor. Labels describe only visible fittings and surfaces; service states and hidden lift machinery were excluded.
